summary: Adjusts property visibility and behaviour in the unified PlanarSurface operation: PatternCenterAt/PatternCenterCustom now show only for Circular, CircularZigZag and Spiral patterns, CutPatternReversed is hidden and no longer honoured for Waterline, and UseStartPoint now only takes effect for Z-Level.

pages.reason: Path/Op/PlanarSurface.py setEditorProperties: PatternCenterAt/PatternCenterCustom hidden for Offset pattern (shown only for Circular/CircularZigZag/Spiral); opExecute: UseStartPoint no longer applied unless the mode is Z-Level, so the surface-scan start point property has no effect

Path/Op/PlanarSurface.py: CutPatternReversed hidden for Waterline and the climb/conventional flip in _executeWaterline removed, so the property no longer affects Waterline output; UseStartPoint restricted to Z-Level
